def fo(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda k:cnt[k])

import json,os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x!=bg]
    mark=max(set(x for r in g for x in r)-{bg})
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    if len(pts)<2: return out
    pts=sorted(pts)
    r1=min(p[0] for p in pts); r3=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c1=min(p[1] for p in pts); c3=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    drs=[pts[k+1][0]-pts[k][0] for k in range(len(pts)-1)]
    dcs=[pts[k+1][1]-pts[k][1] for k in range(len(pts)-1)]
    dr=max(drs, key=drs.index); dc=max(dcs, key=dcs.index)
    nr,nc_=r3+dr,c3+dc
    if nr<H and nc_<W:
        for r in range(0,H):
            if out[r][nc_]==bg: out[r][nc_]=mark
        for cc in range(c1,min(W,nc_+1)):
            if out[nr][cc]==bg: out[nr][cc]=mark
    for j in range(c1,c3+1):
        if out[r1][j]==bg: out[r1][j]=mark
        if out[r3][j]==bg: out[r3][j]=mark
    for i in range(r1,r3+1):
        if out[i][c1]==bg: out[i][c1]=mark
        if out[i][c3]==bg: out[i][c3]=mark
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))
